Built the delivery address form in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- Fields: full name, phone, emirate (select from the 7 UAE emirates), area, building, flat number, delivery notes.
- Required: name, phone, emirate, area (marked with `*`); building, flat number, delivery notes optional.
- Mock data is pre-filled and the form starts in a "submitted" state, so validation errors show immediately for the missing phone number and the invalid flat number (`12/B*`, which fails the allowed letters/numbers/spaces/hyphens pattern) — other fields are valid and show no errors.
- Used logical CSS properties (`inline-size`, `margin-block-*`, etc.) instead of left/right so it mirrors correctly for the `ar-AE` RTL locale, and relied on `--strata-*` CSS custom properties (tokens) for colors/spacing/typography, with safe fallback values, so it adapts to brand/scheme/density via `ThemeScope`.
- Note: `@strata/react` isn't installed in this environment (no `node_modules`), so I couldn't inspect its actual component API — I built the form with plain semantic HTML (`input`/`select`/`textarea`/`label`) rather than guessing at unverified component/prop names, keeping full accessibility (labels, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `role="alert"`).
